landing.heroSubtitle: Create a Bible quiz, share a PIN and play live with your church, youth group or family — everyone in their own language.
landing.step1Text: Write your own questions or pick a ready-made quiz in Discover.
landing.step2Text: Show the PIN and QR code on screen, or send the link on WhatsApp.
landing.step3Text: Everyone answers on their phone at the same time. The leaderboard updates live.
landing.f1Text: Portuguese, French, English and Spanish. Each player sees the questions in their language.
landing.f2Text: A phone browser is all it takes. Join with a PIN, link or QR code in seconds.
landing.f3Text: Each question can show its Bible reference, to dig deeper after the game.
landing.f4Text: More points for fast, correct answers — and a podium at the end.
landing.finalText: Create your account and launch a quiz in under two minutes.
